title: Delta A716RB Victorian Metal Lever Handle Accent, Venetian Bronze

writeup: Delta's A716RB is the Victorian metal lever handle accent in Venetian Bronze, used with Delta's Less Handle Program tub and shower trims. It's the accent piece only, so you'll also need the matching handle base. Home Depot lists it at $22.70 and AF Supply at $27.82.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon listing is Delta Faucet A716RB Victorian Single Metal Lever Handle Accent, Venetian Bronze; matches Woot's ASIN
